secrets.name: GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY
secrets.description: Google Maps Platform key (Map Tiles API) for photorealistic 3D tiles, GEV place search and Street View. Client-exposed by design — restrict it by HTTP referrer in Google Cloud Console → APIs & Services → Credentials. Optional: without it the app starts on keyless Esri World Imagery.

secrets.name: GOOGLE_MAPS_SERVER_API_KEY
secrets.description: Optional separate server-side Google key for Places (/api/google/nearby-places, /api/google/text-search) and the CCTV Street View fallback; falls back to GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY when unset.

secrets.name: CESIUM_ION_TOKEN
secrets.description: Cesium ion public assets:read token (ion imagery, Bing imagery, Cesium World Terrain). Client-exposed — use a URL-restricted token. cesium.com/ion/tokens. Optional.

secrets.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
secrets.description: OpenAI key for Realtime voice control and the HUD summary (/api/realtime/token, /api/openai/hud-summary). platform.openai.com → API keys. Optional: voice stays off without it.

secrets.name: GEMINI_API_KEY
secrets.description: Google AI Studio key for the Gemini Live voice provider (the second entry in the voice provider selector). aistudio.google.com → API keys. Optional.

secrets.name: MAPILLARY_CLIENT_TOKEN
secrets.description: Mapillary client token for the Street Level imagery layer. mapillary.com/dashboard/developers → register an app → Client Token. Client-exposed by design. Optional.

secrets.name: AISSTREAM_API_KEY
secrets.description: AISStream key for the live vessels layer, used server-side by the /api/vessels proxy. aisstream.io. Optional: the layer stays empty without it.

secrets.name: OPENSKY_CLIENT_ID
secrets.description: OpenSky OAuth client id (opensky-network.org account dashboard → API clients). Paired with OPENSKY_CLIENT_SECRET; set OPENSKY_AUTH_MODE=oauth (the default) to use it. Optional: aircraft fall back to anonymous, rate-limited access.

secrets.name: OPENSKY_CLIENT_SECRET
secrets.description: OpenSky OAuth client secret, paired with OPENSKY_CLIENT_ID.

secrets.name: FIRMS_MAP_KEY
secrets.description: NASA FIRMS map key for the Active Fires layer (firms.modaps.eosdis.nasa.gov/api/map_key). Server-side only. Optional: the layer shows "KEY REQUIRED" without it.

secrets.name: TOMTOM_API_KEY
secrets.description: TomTom key for live traffic flow tiles (/api/tomtom/*). my.tomtom.com/keys. Optional: the traffic layer uses its built-in keyless simulation instead.
